title: Youth Employment Fund
purpose: Fund charities that help young people aged 16 to 25 move into work, training or education.
eligibility: Open to registered charities and community interest companies based in the UK that work directly with 16 to 25 year olds facing barriers to employment.
key_requirements: Outline of the programme; evidence of outcomes for young people; budget

title: Scottish Youth Pathways
purpose: Fund youth employment and skills projects delivered in Scotland.
eligibility: Applicants must be organisations registered in Scotland and working with young people aged 16 to 25.

title: American Youth Initiative
purpose: Support youth mentoring and skills programmes run by US nonprofits.
eligibility: Only organisations holding US 501(c)(3) status may apply.

title: Small Charities Boost
purpose: Unrestricted and project grants for small charities working with young people.
eligibility: Charities with an annual income under £250,000.
key_requirements: Latest annual accounts showing income; short project description
exclusions: Charities with income of £250,000 or more

title: Climate Adaptation Research Grant
purpose: Fund university and institute research into how coastal communities can adapt to climate change.
eligibility: Research institutions and charities with a research track record in climate science.
key_requirements: Research proposal; named principal investigator; data management plan

title: Digital Skills for Young People
purpose: Fund programmes that teach practical digital skills to young people aged 16 to 25.
eligibility: UK registered charities delivering digital skills training to young people.
exclusions: Core costs, overheads and general running costs are not funded

title: Established Charities Grant
purpose: Larger grants for established charities delivering youth services.
eligibility: Applicants must provide three years of independently audited accounts.
key_requirements: Three years of audited accounts; trustee report; project plan
exclusions: Organisations with fewer than three years of audited accounts
